entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Artificial intelligence has been hailed as the biggest technological revolution in decades. But has it been oversold?

Award-winning journalist and Empire of AI author Karen Hao joins Guyon Espiner to challenge some of Silicon Valley's biggest claims. They discuss whether AI is really on the path to superintelligence, why companies are pouring billions into the technology, the hidden human labour behind today's AI models, and whether the industry is delivering on its extraordinary promises.

Has the AI revolution raced ahead of reality?| Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1
